title: Flood Advisory issued November 1 at 3:20PM EST until November 1 at 4:15PM EST by NWS Miami FL
description: * WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues. * WHERE...Northeastern Glades County in southern Florida... * WHEN...Until 415 PM EST. * IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas. Water over roadways. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 320 PM EST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated heavy rain due to thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly in the advisory area. Between 3.5 and 4.5 inches of rain have fallen. - Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are expected over the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding. - Some locations that will experience flooding include... Buckhead Ridge and Brighton Seminole Reservation. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
